tasks.title: Доска: поиск неисправности
tasks.statement: Доска с уже собранной, но сломанной средой. В рассказе только симптомы: выберите объекты, прочитайте причины в инспекторе и путь сообщений, найдите уровень и почините доску. Пять сценариев: молчащий хост и машина без сети, дата-центр без мастер-домена, хосты после добавления iSCSI, кластер вне дата-центра и всё красное из-за менеджера. Упражнение решено, когда решены все сценарии.
tasks.hint: Идите от симптома к уровню: NonResponsive — сеть управления, NonOperational — сеть или хранилище хоста, Uninitialized — мастер-домен, No cluster — членство. Запускайте операции и читайте путь сообщений.

scenarios.title: A silent host and a stuck VM
scenarios.story: The engine reports timeouts for host-2, and web-1 will not start although its host, host-1, is Up. Everything else looks fine.
scenarios.goal: All three hosts are Up, the engine reaches them and web-1 can be started
scenarios.hint: Select host-2 and web-1 and read the reasons, then run the start. The engine talks to a host over the management network; a VM needs the network of its virtual NIC on the host it runs on.

scenarios.title: The data center never comes Up
scenarios.story: The Default data center is Uninitialized, host-2 is NonOperational and web-1 is down. The nfs-data domain was created last week.
scenarios.goal: The data center is Up with an SPM, both hosts are Up and web-1 can be started
scenarios.hint: A data center needs an active master domain, and once a domain is attached every host has to see it. Read the reason on host-2 as well: it is a different problem.

scenarios.title: Hosts fail after adding iSCSI
scenarios.story: After the iSCSI LUN iscsi-lun was added, every host is NonOperational, the data center is Non Responsive and the domain is Inactive. Each host reports a slightly different reason.
scenarios.goal: All three hosts are Up and web-1 can be started from the iSCSI domain
scenarios.hint: An iSCSI domain needs a network with the storage role on every host. Compare the reasons of the hosts to see what they share and what differs.

scenarios.title: Where did cluster-b go?
scenarios.story: host-3 shows No cluster, and web-1, which runs on it, is down. host-2 is NonOperational, while host-1 and the data center are fine.
scenarios.goal: All three hosts are Up and web-1 can be started
scenarios.hint: The reason on host-3 names a problem one level above the host. A host that joins a data center needs the same management network and storage as the others.

scenarios.title: Everything is red
scenarios.story: Both hosts are NonResponsive, the data center is Non Responsive, nfs-data is Inactive and web-1 is down. Nobody touched the storage this week.
scenarios.goal: Both hosts are Up, the engine reaches them and web-1 can be started
scenarios.hint: An Inactive domain and a Non Responsive data center are consequences: look at the hosts first. Then read every reason of web-1, because a VM needs its networks and its disk domain too.

tasks.title: Доска: поиск неисправности, сложнее
tasks.statement: Те же приёмы на более крупных досках: два кластера или два дата-центра и несколько машин. Пять сценариев: новый хост, который исправляется по слою за раз, машина, которую рассказ обвиняет в диске, зелёная доска с падающей миграцией, машина и хост удалённого дата-центра и домен, объявленный не тем типом. Упражнение решено, когда решены все сценарии.
tasks.hint: Не верьте рассказу, верьте статусам и пути сообщений. После каждой правки читайте статусы заново: одна неисправность может прятать другую, а зелёные статусы не гарантируют, что операция пройдёт.

scenarios.title: The host that was added yesterday
scenarios.story: host-3 was added to the data center yesterday and still shows No cluster. host-4 is NonOperational, and cache-1, which runs on it, is down.
scenarios.goal: All four hosts are Up and all three VMs are running
scenarios.hint: Fix what the status says, then read the status again: a host reports its problems one layer at a time. A new member needs everything the other hosts of its cluster have.

scenarios.title: A VM that will not start
scenarios.story: db-1 stopped starting right after its disk was moved to the new nfs-fast domain. host-2 and host-4 are NonOperational as well.
scenarios.goal: All four hosts are Up and both VMs are running
scenarios.hint: Do not trust the story: the VM tells you itself why it does not run. The message path of the start shows which hop fails.

scenarios.title: Green board, failing migration
scenarios.story: Every host is Up and every VM is running, but live migration fails for web-1, db-1 and cache-1. Each of them fails for its own reason.
scenarios.goal: Every VM can be live-migrated and everything stays Up
scenarios.hint: Run the migration and read where the path breaks. The target is the first other Up host of the cluster: the VM needs a network shared with it, its own networks there, and a target at all.

scenarios.title: A remote host and a remote VM
scenarios.story: In the Remote data center host-4 is NonOperational and the VM app-1 will not start, while the Default data center is all green. app-2 runs on host-4 and is down too.
scenarios.goal: Both data centers are Up, all hosts are Up and all three VMs are running
scenarios.hint: Networks and storage domains never cross the border of a data center. Follow the start path of app-1 and see which domain it opens.

scenarios.title: Every host rejects the storage
scenarios.story: All four hosts are NonOperational, the data center is Non Responsive and nfs-data is Inactive. The storage team says the NFS server is healthy.
scenarios.goal: All four hosts are Up and both VMs are running
scenarios.hint: Read the reason common to all hosts and ask what the domain is declared to be. Then deal with what is left on host-2 and host-4.
